notes.title: Dev Update #002!
notes.notes:
Draoi,

We're here just to let you know that we're still hard at work on huge updates, with lots of content, spells and more to come!

We'd like to ask you all to bear with us, as we add to and adjust our game, according to the feedback we've gotten so far. 

Thank you for sticking with us!

Looking forward to seeing you out there.

notes.title: Dev Update #001
notes.notes:
Hello!

We've been polishing up all our features to prepare for release in a few weeks and decided it's time for our first Dev Update!

Additions:
-Added Player Groups of up to 5 people (for you and your friends to play together)

-Duelling was added, up to 10 people at once! (So you and your gang can resolve any grievances you have with rival wizards)

Changes:
-Refined our flight mechanic (to allow for some sweet mid-air action)

-Improved the spellcasting recognition


Looking forward to seeing you out there, Draoi.
